#  Supplementary Figure 3: Bivariate correlations between influenza and other respiratory viruses during the post-COVID-19 period (2023–2024)
## Load packages and data
```{r Load package}
library(Kendall);library(psych);
library(dplyr);library(tidyverse);library(tidyr);
library(lubridate);library(ggpubr);library(ggplot2)
dat <- read.csv("../00_data/multi_vaccine_indirect_postcovid19.csv")

position <- read.csv("../00_data/lat_lon.csv")
colnames(position) <-c ("country","lon","lat")
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"
source("../plot_theme.R")

out_path1 <- paste0("FigS4")
dir.create(out_path1)
dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
dat$year <- as.numeric(dat$year)
dat <- dat[which(dat$year >= 2023 & dat$year <= 2024), ]
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"

```


#Bivariate correlations between influenza and other respiratory viruses
```{r spearman_correlation}
virus_name<- unique(dat$virus)
n = length(virus_name)
cor_virus <- data.frame()

# Define number of permutations
num_permutations <- 1000

for (i in c(1:n)){
  print(virus_name[i])
  dat_virus <-  subset(dat ,dat$virus==virus_name[i])
  dat_virus<- dat_virus[order(dat_virus$country,dat_virus$year_decimal,decreasing=F),]
  cntry_name<- unique(dat_virus$country)
  R_virus <-data.frame()
  for (j in c(1:length(cntry_name)))
    {
    print(cntry_name[j])
    R <- matrix(NA, nrow = 1,ncol = 18)
    R <- as.data.frame(R)
    colnames(R)<- c("all_cor","all_p","all_lowci","all_highci",
                    "flua_cor","flua_p","flua_lowci","flua_highci",
                    "flub_cor","flub_p","flub_lowci","flub_highci",
                    "all_ranlow","all_ranhigh","flua_ranlow",
                    "flua_ranhigh","flub_ranlow","flub_ranhigh")
    dat_cntry <-  subset(dat_virus ,dat_virus$country==cntry_name[j])
    
    # Calculate Spearman correlations between influenza and other respiratory viruses
    res_all <- corr.test(dat_cntry$flu_AAP, dat_cntry$AAP, method = "spearman", ci = TRUE)
    R[1,"all_cor"] <- res_all$r
    R[1,"all_p"] <- res_all$p
    R[1,"all_lowci"] <- res_all$ci[1]
    R[1,"all_highci"] <- res_all$ci[3]

    res_flua <- corr.test(dat_cntry$fluA_AAP, dat_cntry$AAP, method = "spearman", ci = TRUE)
    R[1,"flua_cor"] <- res_flua$r
    R[1,"flua_p"] <- res_flua$p
    R[1,"flua_lowci"] <- res_flua$ci[1]
    R[1,"flua_highci"] <- res_flua$ci[3]

    res_flub <- corr.test(dat_cntry$fluB_AAP, dat_cntry$AAP, method = "spearman", ci = TRUE)
    R[1, "flub_cor"] <- res_flub$r
    R[1, "flub_p"] <- res_flub$p
    R[1, "flub_lowci"] <- res_flub$ci[1]
    R[1, "flub_highci"] <- res_flub$ci[3]
   
    # Perform random permutation for null hypothesis
    perm_cor_all <- numeric(num_permutations)
    perm_cor_flua <- numeric(num_permutations)
    perm_cor_flub <- numeric(num_permutations)
    
    for (perm in 1:num_permutations) {
      # Randomly permute the virus prevalence time series (both X and Y)
      perm_dat <- dat_cntry
      perm_dat$AAP <- sample(perm_dat$AAP)  # Randomize AAP

      perm_dat$flu_AAP <- sample(perm_dat$flu_AAP)  # Randomize flu_AAP
      perm_res_all <- corr.test(perm_dat$flu_AAP, perm_dat$AAP, method = "spearman")
      perm_cor_all[perm] <- perm_res_all$r
     
      perm_dat$fluA_AAP <- sample(perm_dat$fluA_AAP)  # Randomize fluA_AAP
      perm_res_flua <- corr.test(perm_dat$fluA_AAP, perm_dat$AAP, method = "spearman")
      perm_cor_flua[perm] <- perm_res_flua$r
    
      perm_dat$fluB_AAP <- sample(perm_dat$fluB_AAP)  # Randomize fluB_AAP
      perm_res_flub <- corr.test(perm_dat$fluB_AAP, perm_dat$AAP, method = "spearman")
      perm_cor_flub[perm] <- perm_res_flub$r
   
    }
   
    # Compute quantiles from the permutation distribution
    R[1, "all_ranlow"] <- quantile(perm_cor_all, 0.025)
    R[1, "all_ranhigh"] <- quantile(perm_cor_all, 0.975)

    R[1, "flua_ranlow"] <- quantile(perm_cor_flua, 0.025)
    R[1, "flua_ranhigh"] <- quantile(perm_cor_flua, 0.975)

    R[1, "flub_ranlow"] <- quantile(perm_cor_flub, 0.025)
    R[1, "flub_ranhigh"] <- quantile(perm_cor_flub, 0.975)
  
    # Add country and virus information to the results
    R$country <- cntry_name[j]
    R$virus <- virus_name[i]

    R_virus <- rbind(R_virus,R)
    }
  cor_virus <- rbind(cor_virus,R_virus)
}
```

## Plot Spearman correlation results for IV
```{r,plot_spearman_correlation_IV,fig.width=10.5, fig.height=12, dpi=300}
write.csv(cor_virus,paste0(out_path1,"/cor_result_postcovid.csv"),row.names = F)
cor_virus1 <- cor_virus
cor_virus <- cor_virus[cor_virus$virus %in% c("INF_ALL", "INF_A", "INF_B", "RSV", 
                                                   "PIV", "RV", "ADV", "HMPV"), ]
# Create all combinations of viruses and countries
all_combinations <- expand_grid(
    virus = unique(cor_virus$virus),
    country = unique(cor_virus$country)
)

# Merge correlation results with all combinations
cor_virus <- merge(all_combinations, cor_virus, by = c("virus", "country"), all.x = TRUE)
cor_virus$virus <- factor(cor_virus$virus,
                               levels = c("INF_ALL","INF_A","INF_B",
                                          "RSV","PIV","RV","ADV","HMPV","HCoV"),ordered=TRUE)

cor_flu_all <- cor_virus[,c("virus","country","all_cor","all_p","all_lowci","all_highci", 
                            "all_ranlow","all_ranhigh" )]
cor_flu_all$fill_all <- with(cor_flu_all, ifelse(all_p > 0.05, "NS", 
                                    ifelse(all_cor > 0, "Positive", "Negative")))

# Format P-values for plotting
cor_flu_all$cor_p <- ifelse(cor_flu_all$all_p < 0.01, 
                           "p<0.01", sprintf("%.2f", cor_flu_all$all_p))
cor_flu_all$country <- factor(cor_flu_all$country,
                       levels = position$country[order(position$lat, decreasing = F)],ordered=TRUE)

p1_IV <- ggplot(cor_flu_all, aes(virus,country)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill=fill_all),color = "black",size=0.1, alpha=0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("NS" = "gray75", "Positive" = "#dc3637", "Negative" = "#377eb8"),
                       na.value = "white")+
    labs(title ="IV" ,x="",y="") + 
    geom_text(aes(label = cor_p), size = 5, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0))+
    mytheme+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, color="black",vjust = 0.5,hjust = 0.5, angle = 0),
            strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))+
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.5,"cm"),legend.key.width = unit(1.5,"cm"),
          legend.key.height  = unit(0.5,"cm"),legend.position = c("bottom"))+
    theme(plot.margin=unit(c(1,1,0.25,0.5),'lines'),
          panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))+
    theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank())+ 
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))

  p1_IV 


cor_flu_all$cor_value <- paste0(round(cor_flu_all$all_cor,2)," (",round(cor_flu_all$all_ranlow,2),",",
                                round(cor_flu_all$all_ranhigh,2),")")  
cor_flu_all[which(is.na(cor_flu_all$cor_p)),"cor_value"] <- NA
cor_flu_all$country <- factor(cor_flu_all$country,
                       levels = position$country[order(position$lat, decreasing = F)],ordered=TRUE)

p2_IV <- ggplot(cor_flu_all, aes(virus,country)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill=fill_all),color = "black",size=0.1,alpha=0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("NS" = "gray75", "Positive" = "#dc3637", "Negative" = "#377eb8"),

   guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

```{r,fig.width=21, fig.height=30, dpi=300}
                 p2_IAV,p2_IV,p2_IBV,
                 ncol =3, nrow = 2,widths = c(1,1),
                labels = c("A","","","B","",""),  vjust=1,align = "hv",
                font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"))

ggsave(figs4,filename = file.path(paste0(out_path1,"/FigS4_cor_post.pdf")),
         width = 28,height =24,device   = cairo_pdf,  family   = "Arial")
```

## Proportion of countries with significant correlations with IAV during the post-COVID-19 period
```{r proportion_significant_correlations_post}
dat_post <- read.csv("FigS4/cor_result_postcovid.csv")
# Calculate the proportion of countries with significant correlations
prop_sig_post <- dat_post %>%
  group_by(virus) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_sig = sum(flua_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_sig = n_sig / n_total
  )

prop_sig_post 

```
